description: Fetch a YouTube channel's profile card: name, @handle, channel ID, avatar, subscriber count, total video count, and full description. The channel parameter accepts an @handle (e.g. "@ExampleChannel") or any channel URL (/@handle, /channel/UC..., /c/...). Lightweight — does not fetch the content list (use youtube/channel-videos for that). No authentication required for public channels.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel @handle or channel URL. Four input forms: (1) @handle, e.g. "@ExampleChannel"; (2) youtube.com/@handle/ (trailing slash optional); (3) youtube.com/channel/UC... (channel ID URL); (4) youtube.com/c/... (legacy custom URL, only works for channels that own that alias). Discovery: click the channel name under any video, or use the channel.handle / channel.channelId field from youtube/get-video. A bare name without @ is also accepted and auto-completed to an @handle.
